notes.title: Additional languages supported! (Chinese, Vietnamese, Spanish, Portuguese)
notes.content:
Additional localization has been completed for the following languages:
[list]
[*] Simplified Chinese
[*] Vietnamese
[*] Spanish
[*] Portuguese
[/list]

Thank you.

notes.title: 1.5.2 Hot Fix
notes.content:
다음과 같은 문제가 발견되어 이를 조치하였습니다.
[list]
[*] 모든 스테이지를 All 3성으로 최초 클리어 시 스팀 도전과제가 정상적으로 달성되지 않는 문제.
[*] 해당 문제 발생 시, 게임에 재진입하면 미달성된 스팀 도전과제가 달성되도록 수정.
[/list]

The following issues were identified and have been addressed:
[list]
[*] An issue where the Steam achievement would not unlock properly when clearing all stages with 3 stars for the first time.
[*] If this issue occurs, re-entering the game will now trigger the achievement unlock for any previously unregistered progress.
[/list]
